name: Cancellation Processing Status 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status of a cancellation request.

CANP.name: Pending Cancellation
CANP.definition: Cancellation is pending. It is not known at this time whether cancellation can be affected.

EXCH.name: Received At Stock Exchange
EXCH.definition: Cancellation has been received at the stock exchange.

INTE.name: Received At Intermediary
INTE.definition: Cancellation has been received at the intermediary.

PACK.name: Accepted
PACK.definition: Cancellation request has been acknowledged for further processing by the account servicer.

PARF.name: Partially Filled
PARF.definition: Order is partially filled, cancellation processing accepted for the remainder.

REJT.name: Rejected
REJT.definition: Cancellation has been rejected for further processing.
